content: Thank you for taking some time off from your busy schedule to answer a few questions about your life.
Could you tell us about an average day in your life?
Sure. I get up early at 7 in the morning and then I have breakfast. After breakfast I go to the gym?
Yes, I'm watching a new film called The Man About Town.
What do you do in the afternoon?
First, I have lunch then I go to the studio and shoot some scenes.
Which scene are you acting today?
I'm acting the scene about an angry lover.
That's very interesting. What do you do in the evening?
I usually take a walk outside after dinner and then spend some time remembering my lines.
How do you spend your weekend? Do you go shopping or go to parties a lot?
No, I'd rather stay at home reading some books.
